title: Storm Wizard Cats
description: Three mystical cats sit on rocky outcrops during a dramatic thunderstorm. A grey cat on the left exhales magical smoke, a black cat with cosmic fur and glowing green eyes stands center, while an orange tabby on the right conjures floating orbs containing tiny witch figures amid purple lightning.
prompt: Three magical cats perched on mountain rocks in the middle of a violent thunderstorm at dusk. A grey cat with glowing blue patterns breathes ethereal smoke, a black cat with starry nebula fur and bright green eyes stands in the center with its mouth open, and an orange tabby cat on the right raises its paw to conjure floating transparent spheres containing tiny witch silhouettes. Dramatic purple lightning strikes across a turbulent sky, volcanic mountain in the background, cinematic fantasy style, highly detailed, vibrant colors.
